info.name: player-service
info.description: player-service (Team 19, Topic 3 — Student ID, Please): CRUD, progression and the error contract, as of Lab 4 (`decision.evaluated` and `session.closed` arrive from the Message Broker; the REST stand-in is local only, see its folder). Run the folders top to bottom, or use the Collection Runner: later requests use {{playerId}} and {{decisionPlayerId}} captured on the way. Calls go through the API Gateway (`baseUrl` http://localhost:8080) with the API key from the `apiKey` variable as `Authorization: Bearer` (one of the keys in GATEWAY_API_KEYS; never stored here). Every request sends its own `X-Request-Id` and checks that it comes back, and every error is checked for the `{error, message}` shape. Instance status and metrics need `playerInstanceUrl` (see that folder).

item.name: Instance Status And Metrics (direct, local only)
item.description: `GET /health` (status with load, polled by the Service Discovery), `GET /actuator/prometheus` (scraped by Prometheus) and `GET /internal/logs` (the requests the Gateway's `GET /logs` collects, Lab 4) aren't routed by the Gateway, and Compose doesn't publish the instances' ports. Set `playerInstanceUrl` to reach one instance directly (e.g. `http://localhost:8081` for a jar run locally, or `http://player-service:8081` for newman on the Compose network); empty, the two requests are skipped.
